disposition_reason: Seventy-two pooled samples of six leafy vegetables from Rafsanjan distribution centers across four seasons of 2024 were analysed by ICP-MS; Tables 1-2 give seasonal mean ± SD for eleven elements and the text gives annual means.

study.design: Seasonal market survey of six edible leafy vegetables with health risk assessment
study.market: 10 raw-vegetable distribution centers, Rafsanjan, Kerman province, Iran
study.period_text: four seasons of 2024, one month per season
study.method: Oven drying 70 °C, dry ashing 500 °C 4 h, HNO3 then HCl digestion; ICP-MS (Agilent HP 4500)
study.lod_text: within 0.01 mg/kg for As, Hg, Pb, Cd; within 0.1 mg/kg for Cr, Ni, Cu, Mn, Zn; up to 10 mg/kg for Fe, Al
